idle.note: the protagonist's cut-out bob: the upper body drops 2 px and returns as one rigid piece; the spear arm and the planted spear stay still (as the Seer's staff); cloak, loin panel and boots still

move.note: the protagonist's walk: both legs step, six steps per tile, near foot leading; the free arm swings 3 px; the spear is lifted 3 px off the floor and tipped back 4 degrees while carried; a 3 degree lean; the cloak trails 2 px

lunge.note: draws the spear back and up on a planted stance, then drives the body through a long thrust: the spear swings from upright to nearly level along the struck line (contact), the hips dip 2 px, the free fist pulls back as a counterweight; holds the thrust, then recovers

jab.note: a short, quick poke at the end of the advance: the spear tips down to 60 degrees and pokes 12 px forward (contact), then snaps back upright

cast.note: raises the spear high and tips it back, then snaps the point down at the target to loose the shard (contact); the free hand lifts with the raise

pin.note: levels the spear at the target and holds it dead still (aim), then a sharp release with a 2 px recoil (contact)

guard.note: settles into a crouch behind the upright spear, the free fist raised to guard and the cloak drawn forward; holds; then eases back

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, the spear tips back 3 degrees, cloak flicks 2 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: staggers back, the spear slips from the grip at 0.3 and topples forward about its foot; the knees buckle into a kneel (hips drop 16 px) and the torso folds forward 20 degrees, hood bowed; the cloak settles; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
